profile.name: Vladislav Larionov
profile.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 10+ years in product development and 4+ years leading a team of 5.

I led an AngularJS to Angular 17 migration with zero downtime, built a real-time BI platform used by ~300 external clients and a no-code A/B testing platform used by ~200 clients, and delivered a GovTech mobile MVP in 6 months.
Hands-on with AI-assisted development and LLM / RAG / MCP integrations.

experience.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
highlights: Delivered the product MVP in 6 months as one of 3 engineers; launched to a pilot with test users.
Built the web and mobile app (React/Next.js, Capacitor) on a Django/PostgreSQL backend.
Built push notifications end to end: backend triggers, native delivery (incl. FCM), scalable front-end handling.
Developed interactive maps with custom themes and 3D objects for the mobile app.
Turned Figma designs into development plans and implemented complex multi-layer animations in React.
Set up and maintained AWS infrastructure with Terraform (Docker, Redis, PostgreSQL).
Designed an AI assistant architecture over internal data and services (RAG / MCP approaches).

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer
highlights: Led a team of 5 developers; grew 4 juniors to senior level and shortened the release cycle from 4 to 3 weeks.

Led the phased AngularJS to Angular 17 migration of a large no-code, configuration-driven application: zero migration-related downtime, all client configurations preserved, +30% render performance, -50% build time.
Designed and delivered a low-code BI dashboard with real-time reports and a queue-based notification service for exports; used by ~100 people in 3 departments and ~300 external clients.
Built or migrated 1,000+ reports from the legacy system; auto-filters halved report setup time.
Delivered a no-code A/B testing platform used by ~200 clients (~1,000 concurrent experiments), saving ~30 dev-hours a month and enabling a new paid subscription tier.
Contributed to the ColdFusion to C# migration of the core backend: architecture design and development.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Started the migration of the main ColdFusion monolith to C# and a microservices architecture.
Cut client configuration load time from 15 s to 3 s by optimizing legacy components and database queries.
Built and maintained full-stack business applications with Angular, ColdFusion and MSSQL.
